hiddenCopy: The latest Lenovo Yoga products span our full Yoga lineup. We regularly update each product lineup with the latest advancements in design, performance, and AI innovation.
The current lineup includes:

Yoga 2-in-1 Series: Versatile convertibles with 360° hinges designed for flexible use across laptop, tent, stand, and tablet modes. These devices support pen and touch input, making them well-suited for note-taking, sketching, and interactive workflows. (e.g., Yoga 7 2-in-1, Yoga 9i 2-in-1)
Yoga Slim Series: Ultra-thin, lightweight clamshell laptops focused on portability, long battery life, and efficient performance for everyday productivity and mobility. (e.g., Slim 7i, Slim 7x)
Yoga Pro Series: High-performance laptops built for creators and power users, offering advanced processors, strong graphics capabilities, and premium display technologies. (e.g., Pro 7, Pro 9i)

Yoga Book Series: Innovative dual-screen and unique form factor devices designed for multitasking and creative workflows. These also support pen input, enabling digital writing, design, and extended screen interactions. (e.g., Yoga Book 9i)
Lenovo Yoga Slim, Yoga Pro, and Yoga 2-in-1 mainly differ in how they are built:

Yoga Slim: Thin, lightweight clamshell laptops designed for high portability and long battery life. They are well-suited for users who need a device for everyday productivity, mobility, and extended use on the go.

Yoga Pro: Clamshell laptops built with more powerful components and larger thermal capacity to handle demanding workloads. They are built to handle heavy tasks such as content creation, multitasking, and performance-intensive applications.

Yoga 2-in-1: Convertible laptops with a 360-degree hinge that allows use in laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes. These devices also support pen and touch input, making them suitable for notetaking, sketching, presentations, and interactive workflows.
Together, these Yoga categories cover portability, performance, and flexibility based on different user needs.
Lenovo Yoga laptops support a wide range of use cases depending on the model and configuration, including productivity, content creation, media consumption, and mobile work.

Yoga Slim: Well-suited for portability-focused workflows such as everyday productivity, web-based tasks, and content creation tasks such as photo editing and video editing, along with media viewing on the go.
Yoga Pro: Designed for performance-intensive workloads, including 3D rendering, animation, 4K video editing, gaming, and advanced creative applications.
Yoga 2-in-1: Ideal for flexible and interactive use, including notetaking, annotation, presentations, and pen-based input across multiple modes.
Yoga Book: Built for dual-screen multitasking, digital workflows, and creative use cases that benefit from extended screen space and touch interaction.
The specific applications each device can handle depend on the processor, memory, graphics, and storage configuration.
Yoga laptops are designed for versatile everyday computing, combining performance, flexibility, and premium features to support a wide range of tasks.
They are commonly used for:
Productivity and work: Yoga laptops handle office applications, web browsing, video calls, and multitasking smoothly, thanks to modern processors and fast storage.
Multitasking and performance-heavy tasks: Higher-end products (like Yoga Pro) can support demanding workloads such as video editing, 3D rendering, gaming, coding, or design work.
Content consumption and entertainment: High-quality displays and audio make them well-suited for streaming, media viewing, and casual gaming.

Creative tasks: Select Yoga models include touchscreen support, and Yoga 2-in-1 devices are specifically designed for pen input and flexible modes, enabling sketching, notetaking, and creative workflows.
Flexible usage on the go: Yoga 2-in-1 devices feature a 360° hinge that allows switching between laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes for different scenarios.

faqItems.question: What is Lenovo Yoga?
faqItems.answer: Lenovo Yoga is a premium ecosystem of laptops, desktops, tablets, and accessories designed around performance, mobility, and versatility. While known for its signature 2-in-1 convertible laptops, Yoga represents a broader portfolio spanning multiple form factors to support different ways of working, creating, and consuming content. This includes clamshell laptops for traditional productivity, convertibles for flexible use, dual-screen designs such as Yoga Book for creative workflows, and All-in-One PCs for streamlined desktop setups. Yoga devices are built to support flexible work, creativity, entertainment, and everyday productivity through features such as high-quality displays, advanced processors, and adaptable designs. Yoga laptops differentiate themselves through their premium design, versatility, and focus on refined user experiences. While many Yoga products are known for their flexible 2-in-1 form factors, featuring 360-degree hinges, touchscreen displays, and pen support, the lineup also includes ultra-slim clamshell and performance-focused devices. faqItems.question: What laptop form factors are available in the Lenovo Yoga lineup?
faqItems.answer: The Yoga lineup includes a range of form factors designed to suit different user needs, including clamshell, 2-in-1, and dual-screen designs. Clamshell products offer a traditional laptop experience with a focus on portability, performance, and premium design. Our 2-in-1 products feature a 360-degree hinge that enables use in laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes for added flexibility. Dual-screen devices, such as Lenovo Yoga Book products, replace the traditional keyboard with a second display to support multitasking and creative workflows.

faqItems.question: How does the Lenovo Yoga Book differ from other Yoga devices?
faqItems.answer: The Lenovo Yoga Book is architecturally distinct from every other product in the Lenovo Yoga lineup. In place of a standard keyboard deck, it features a second display panel on the lower chassis, enabling a fully screen-based interaction product. Both panels support touch input, and the lower display can function as a virtual keyboard, drawing surface, or secondary screen. This dual-display structure makes the Lenovo Yoga Book distinct from the Slim, Pro, and 2-in-1 configurations.

faqItems.answer: Lenovo Yoga laptops are designed for users with evolving workflows who value portability, creativity, versatility, and premium experiences. Yoga Pro devices are well suited for creators, designers, video editors, and power users who require higher performance for demanding creative and dynamic workloads. Yoga 2-in-1 devices support adaptable experiences, with flexible designs, touch support, and pen capabilities. These capabilities support sketching, handwriting notes, brainstorming, and seamless transitions between typing, presenting, and interacting with touch on screen. Yoga Slim devices are often chosen by users who prioritize ultra-portability, sleek design, and reliable performance for daily workflows, travel, entertainment, and on-the-go productivity.

Clamshell models like Yoga Slim and Yoga Pro focus on portability and performance, with select configurations offering touchscreen options. Yoga 2-in-1 models are designed for both touchscreen and pen interaction, featuring a 360° hinge that enables laptop, tablet, tent, and stand modes. Yoga Book products are designed for dual-display workflows and creative multitasking. Next, consider the level of performance and features you need. DifferYoga products offer varying combinations of processors, display quality, size, and battery life. faqItems.question: Are Lenovo Yoga laptops good for gaming?
faqItems.answer: Yoga laptops can handle light to moderate gaming, especially higher-performance Yoga Pro products. With powerful processors, optional discrete graphics, and high-quality displays, they run many popular and casual games smoothly. While Yoga devices are designed primarily for productivity and creativity, they offer reliable gaming performance for everyday use, making them a versatile choice for work and play. Always check the specifications of the game with the specs of the device to ensure compatibility.

faqItems.question: Do Lenovo Yoga laptops support touch, pen input, and other interactive features?
faqItems.answer: Yes, Lenovo Yoga laptops support interactive features such as touch and, on supported models, pen input. Yoga 2-in-1 devices are specifically designed for this experience, featuring responsive touchscreen displays and a 360° hinge that lets you switch between laptop, tablets, tent, and stand modes. Many products also support active pen input, and some include a stylus, offering features like pressure sensitivity, palm rejection, and tilt support on select devices. Select Lenovo Yoga laptops also feature Force Pad, a pressure-sensitive touchpad that can support pen-like input for added precision. Availability of Force Pad and pen support varies by model, check specifications for inclusion. Combined with Windows Ink integration, Yoga laptops enable natural writing, sketching, and on-screen i

faqItems.question: Do all Yoga laptops come with a stylus?
faqItems.answer: Not all Lenovo Yoga laptops come with a stylus. Many products support pen input, but availability depends on the specific device and configuration. Some Yoga laptops include a stylus in the box, while others support compatible pens that are sold separately. Stylus support is most commonly available on Yoga 2-in-1 products, select Yoga Book models, and select Yoga Pro devices. Products without active pen support do not support stylus input. For exact details, it’s best to check the specifications of your specific Yoga laptop.

faqItems.question: What AI features are available to enhance productivity on Yoga laptops?
faqItems.answer: Lenovo Yoga laptops include AI-driven features designed to improve productivity through on-device processing and system optimization. These capabilities are supported by processors with integrated NPUs on select products, enabling functions such as adaptive performance tuning, background task management, and responsiveness adjustments. Some configurations also support Lenovo AI applications, and Windows-based AI features that assist with content creation, workflow organization, and system personalization.

faqItems.answer: Yes, Lenovo Yoga laptops are well-suited for everyday use. Many products also include practical features such as all-day battery life, rapid charging, and multiple usage modes (laptop, tablet, tent, or stand), making them convenient for both productivity and everyday activities at home, work, or on the go. faqItems.question: Do Lenovo Yoga laptops come with AI features?
faqItems.answer: Yes, many of the latest Yoga laptops include built-in AI features. These devices are designed as AI PCs, combining dedicated AI hardware (such as NPUs) with Windows 11 capabilities to enhance everyday use. AI features help optimize performance and battery efficiency, improve video calls with tools like background blur and noise reduction, and enable productivity experiences such as Microsoft Copilot. Many newer Yoga products are also part of the Copilot PC category, supporting fast, on-device AI processing for a more responsive and efficient experience. In addition, select Yoga devices offer Lenovo Qira, a Personal Ambient Intelligence feature across the Lenovo ecosystem. It enables context-aware assistance such as summarization, suggestions, writing support, and cross-device continuity, d

faqItems.question: How good is the battery life on Lenovo Yoga laptops?
faqItems.answer: Lenovo Yoga laptops generally offer good to very good battery life, with most products designed to last through a typical workday. In real-world use, 8 to 12 hours can be achieved, depending on the product and usage, while lighter tasks may extend this further. Battery performance varies based on factors like display type, brightness, and workload, so it is best to check the specific product specifications for exact estimates.

faqItems.question: What connectivity options do Yoga laptops offer?
faqItems.answer: Yoga laptops provide multiple connectivity options based on the specific product. Available ports can include USB-C®, USB-A, and HDMI®, with select Lenovo Yoga models also featuring Thunderbolt™ 4 and USB4® for expanded high-speed connectivity. Thunderbolt™ 4 and USB4® support data transfer, external display output, and device charging through a single cable, depending on configuration. Wireless capabilities typically include WiFi 6 or WiFi 6E, and in select configurations, WiFi 7 along with Bluetooth®. The number and type of ports are determined by the device’s hardware design and integrated features.

faqItems.question: Do Yoga laptops support external monitors and docking?
faqItems.answer: Yes, Lenovo Yoga laptops enable external monitors and docking through integrated display output interfaces. They connect to displays and docking solutions using supported ports such as USB-C®, HDMI®, Thunderbolt™ 4, or USB4®. Multi-display capability, resolution, and refresh rate are defined by the graphics subsystem and display configuration.

faqItems.question: Does the Yoga Series support fast charging?
faqItems.answer: Yes, Lenovo Yoga laptops support fast charging. Yoga devices support Lenovo Rapid Charge technologies, including Rapid Charge Express, which can provide up to approximately 3 hours of usage with around 15 minutes of charging under defined conditions. Charging performance varies based on battery capacity, power adapter wattage (such as 65W or higher), and system usage.

faqItems.question: What security features are available on Yoga laptops?
faqItems.answer: Lenovo Yoga laptops include a range of built-in security and privacy features designed to help protect user data and enhance device security. Depending on the model and configuration, these features may include fingerprint readers, facial recognition support through Windows Hello, privacy webcam shutters, and firmware-level protections. Some Yoga devices may also support additional security capabilities such as device encryption and secure sign-in features. Availability of specific security features can vary by product and configuration.

faqItems.question: Are the speakers on the Lenovo Yoga certified or tuned by a well-known brand?
faqItems.answer: Yes, many Yoga laptops feature audio systems that are certified or tuned by Dolby, a globally recognized audio technology brand. Lenovo has partnered with Dolby to integrate Dolby Atmos®, which enhances clarity, balance, and spatial sound for a more immersive experience. On Lenovo Yoga products, Dolby technology is used to optimize the built-in speakers through custom tuning, improving dialogue clarity, stereo separation, and overall sound quality. Some premium Yoga devices, like Yoga 9i 2-in-1 and Yoga Book 9i also include advanced speaker designs, such as hinge-based soundbars, to deliver consistent audio across different usage modes. However, audio features can vary by product and configuration, so it is best to check the specifications of a specific Yoga device for details.

faqItems.question: What is the Lenovo Aura Edition imagined with Intel® in the Yoga lineup?
faqItems.answer: Lenovo Aura Edition, imagined with Intel®, represents a collaboration between Lenovo and Intel® to deliver a more personalized and streamlined PC experience. These devices combine optimized hardware, software, and AI-powered features. Within the Yoga lineup, Aura Edition devices combine premium design, intelligent performance capabilities, and enhanced experiences tailored for creativity and responsive workflows. For more information, visit the Lenovo Aura Edition page

faqItems.question: Does Lenovo Yoga support Smart Connect?
faqItems.answer: Yes, select Lenovo Yoga laptops support Lenovo Smart Connect, depending on the model and software support. Smart Connect is a cross-device ecosystem feature that enables seamless interaction between supported Lenovo PCs, tablets, and smartphones. On compatible Yoga devices, it allows users to share files, sync notifications, use cross-device clipboard, stream apps, and manage content across devices without manual transfers. Feature availability varies by device model, operating system version, and regional support, and some capabilities may require pairing with other supported Lenovo or Motorola devices.
